searchText: hey i am looking to hack on rust EVM client (hello Reth). Mostly want to experiment with a few consensus/p2p optimization. Looking for a client that is modular where I work below the EVM in a silo. I don't want to take the COSMOS sdk route , just like that. Any recommendations for rust ETH clients ? only other one is akula yes I came across Lighthouse, Akula and Reth. Akula has been abandoned , Reth seems to be in active development (i.e. not production ready). So that leaves lighthouse - how is light house ? lighthouse doesn't have evm Ah great, just need the consensus client. Hopefully some EVM implementation can be integrated. Also what parts are missing in Reth, assuming its up to date with akula feature set. reth isn't a consensus client lighthouse is only available rust CL client got it, So i'll need to pair (Reth/Akula) + Lighthouse ? What is the most widely Rust stack, if you know ? idk if akula ended up supporting the engine api? so there isn't really a full rust stack of clients yet - reth+lighthouse is on track to becoming that thanks for the info. Where can i find more documentation on engine API (like ABCI) and other specs, hopefully video introductions and people to bug. ethereum/execution-apis
